aesthetic-hypertrophy.name: Aesthetic Engine: 5-Day Hypertrophy
aesthetic-hypertrophy.description: A 5-day bodybuilding split engineered for maximum hypertrophy, structural balance, and aesthetic muscle development using commercial gym equipment.
guidelines: Train with high mechanical tension: take working sets within 1–2 reps of technical failure.
Control the eccentric (lowering) phase for 2–3 seconds on all isolation and machine movements.
Log weights and reps accurately every session to apply progressive overload week over week.
Rest 2–3 minutes on heavy compound lifts and 60–90 seconds on isolation accessories.
Prioritize recovery: stay hydrated, hit your daily protein target, and get 7–9 hours of sleep.

aesthetic-push-a.title: Chest & Triceps
aesthetic-push-a.focus: Upper chest, front/side delts, and triceps volume

aesthetic-pull-a.title: Back & Biceps
aesthetic-pull-a.focus: Lat width, upper back thickness, and elbow flexor hypertrophy

aesthetic-legs-a.title: Quads & Calves
aesthetic-legs-a.focus: Quad hypertrophy, knee stability, and calf development

aesthetic-upper-b.title: Shoulders & Back
aesthetic-upper-b.focus: Shoulder cap fullness, chest density, and arm specialization

aesthetic-lower-b.title: Glutes & Hams
aesthetic-lower-b.focus: Posterior chain power, glute fullness, and abdominal trunk rigidity

powerbuilding-strength.name: Heavy & Built: 4-Day Powerbuilding
powerbuilding-strength.description: A 4-day heavy compound powerbuilding split blending foundational powerlifting strength (Squat, Bench, Deadlift, OHP) with high-yield hypertrophy.
guidelines: Primary barbell lifts are performed heavy with 3–5 minute rest periods to maximize force production.
Accessory work focuses on high-tension hypertrophy with 90–120 second rest intervals.
Record exact weights and reps to progress through linear periodization.
Always maintain rigid brace and neutral spine on heavy compounds; leave 1 rep in reserve.

pb-squat-strength.title: Heavy Squat
pb-squat-strength.focus: Maximal squat power, quad density, and core bracing

pb-bench-strength.title: Heavy Bench
pb-bench-strength.focus: Pectoral force production, triceps lockout, and horizontal pulling balance

pb-deadlift-strength.title: Heavy Deadlift
pb-deadlift-strength.focus: Posterior chain maximal strength, back thickness, and hamstring development

pb-press-volume.title: Overhead Press
pb-press-volume.focus: Vertical pressing overhead power, lat pulldowns, and arm hypertrophy

classic-ppl.name: Pure PPL: 6-Day Push Pull Legs
classic-ppl.description: The gold-standard high-frequency split for dedicated lifters, hitting each muscle group twice weekly with optimal volume distribution.
guidelines: Workout order: Push 1, Pull 1, Legs 1, Push 2, Pull 2, Legs 2, Rest.
Workout 1 days emphasize heavy compound loading; Workout 2 days emphasize hypertrophy variation and pump.
Leave 1–2 clean reps in reserve on early sets; take the final set of accessories to technical failure.
Ensure high daily calorie and protein intake to support 6 days of training.

ppl-push-1.title: Chest & Delts
ppl-push-1.focus: Horizontal pressing power, overhead strength, and triceps

ppl-pull-1.title: Deadlift & Back
ppl-pull-1.focus: Posterior chain strength, lat width, and biceps mass

ppl-legs-1.title: Squat & Hams
ppl-legs-1.focus: Heavy quad squat loading, hamstring hinge, and core

ppl-push-2.title: Upper Chest
ppl-push-2.focus: Incline pressing, lateral shoulder volume, and pec fly pump

ppl-pull-2.title: Lats & Biceps
ppl-pull-2.focus: Bodyweight pulling, horizontal row volume, and arm thickness

ppl-legs-2.title: Legs & Abs
ppl-legs-2.focus: Anterior quad loading, unilateral balance, and calf specialization

full-body-classic.name: Classic Foundation: 3-Day Full Body
full-body-classic.description: A time-tested 3-day full body compound routine built for maximum strength and muscle stimulus in 3 efficient weekly sessions.
guidelines: Perform workouts on non-consecutive days (e.g. Monday, Wednesday, Friday).
Focus on progressive overload on the main compound barbell lifts.
Take 2–3 minute rest on heavy compounds and 90 seconds on isolation lifts.

fb-workout-a.title: Squat & Chest
fb-workout-a.focus: Squat strength, horizontal press, horizontal row, and core

fb-workout-b.title: Deadlift & Press
fb-workout-b.focus: Deadlift power, overhead pressing, vertical pulling, and single-leg strength

fb-workout-c.title: Legs & Back
fb-workout-c.focus: Leg hypertrophy, incline upper chest, bodyweight pull, and posterior chain

home-forge-dumbbells.name: Home Forge: 4-Day Dumbbell Split
home-forge-dumbbells.description: A complete 4-day Upper/Lower split designed exclusively for dumbbells and bodyweight. No specialized machines required.
guidelines: Use adjustable or pair dumbbells with manageable micro-increments.
Maintain strict form and full range of motion to maximize hypertrophy without heavy machines.
Take 90–120 seconds rest between sets.

hf-upper-a.title: Chest & Back
hf-upper-a.focus: Horizontal dumbbell pressing, lat rows, and shoulder volume

hf-lower-a.title: Quads & Hams
hf-lower-a.focus: Goblet squats, dumbbell RDLs, and calf development

hf-upper-b.title: Shoulders & Arms
hf-upper-b.focus: Incline pressing, chest-supported rows, floor pressing, and biceps

hf-lower-b.title: Glutes & Core
hf-lower-b.focus: Unilateral leg loading, glute development, and core stability

athletic-performance.name: Athletic Engine: 3-Day Performance
athletic-performance.description: A 3-day athletic performance program designed to build explosive lower body power, rotational core stability, vertical jump, and work capacity.
guidelines: Perform all power exercises (jumps, push press, swings) first while neurologically fresh.
Move every rep with explosive intent.
Rest 2–3 minutes on power and compound lifts.

ap-lower-power.title: Lower Power
ap-lower-power.focus: Trap bar deadlift power, vertical box jumps, unilateral acceleration

ap-upper-power.title: Upper Power
ap-upper-power.focus: Push press power, weighted pull-up strength, and horizontal row capacity

ap-work-capacity.title: Conditioning & Core
ap-work-capacity.focus: Front squat anterior strength, kettlebell swings, farmer carries, and jump rope
